_comment: Every route in frontend/App.tsx (plus the audit-only /__layer-fixtures page, url instead of path). path = hash path (HashRouter). mode = the mock session mode the page needs (load the app with ?audit=<mode> first; the mode is kept for the tab). click = visible text of a tab/toggle button to press before auditing (tabs only; never a button that generates, saves or sends). label must be unique; it names the result file. group: shell = inside Layout; public / auth / onboarding / admin = outside it. otherSession = page redesigned in another session (rebrand-on-prod / rebrand-nebulaa-landing): audited read-only, reported separately and left out of the totals. expectHash = where the route is expected to land (default: path). duplicateOf = a redirect that lands on another listed route: audited to prove the redirect, left out of totals.

routes.label: layer-fixtures-gaps
routes.note: known gaps, reported NOT gated: real markup on fills where neither white nor ink reaches 4.5:1 (layer-needs-fix.json); fix on the page (Task 8).

routes.label: layer-fixtures
routes.note: static page served by the audit server only (vite.audit.config.mjs): the click-only and SVG cases of the override layer (lightbox, DraftPreviewModal, dark panels, saturated fills and brand tiles, inline-style fills, toggles, fields, scrims). Open http://127.0.0.1:3100/__layer-fixtures?audit=fixture and run __auditStart(null, <width>).

routes.label: dashboard
routes.note: Home reads GET /api/home/summary (real-shaped mock in mock-session.js). Variants (load /?audit=normal&homestate=<state> first, kept for the tab): full (default), new (nothing yet, unfinished profile), free, nosocials, building (plan being built), client (agency client workspace; ?audit=agency-client shows it by itself), degraded (some sources failed: each block says so), error, slow. The Setup and This week cards follow ?setupstate= mid|fresh|done and ?weekstate= ready|partly|approved|top_up|no_plan|skipped|not_eligible. The page keeps the last summary for 60 seconds per account in sessionStorage: clear keys starting nb.home between states. Your competitors, What's working and Trending for you read GET /api/competitors/best-posts and follow ?compstate= all|locked|empty|error|trackeroff|waiting|states|few. Each best post has Make a post in response and Draft a witty comment (GET /api/home/drafts/options, POST /api/home/response-post and /witty-comment), which follow ?draftstate= ok|blocked|error|limit|busy|balance|off|locked|slow.

routes.label: inbox
routes.note: Inbox states (load /?audit=normal&inboxstate=<state> first, second pass, impact-maps/inbox-reviews.md): full (default: live updates on, 3 approvals, 5 conversation rows, a thread with drafted suggestions, Google with 2 reviews) | empty (connected, nothing yet: the welcome list) | notconnected (connect tile with the Instagram and Facebook marks) | noaddon (Add-on chips, calm note with See plans, explainer) | syncfailing (live updates could not be switched on: warm note with Try again; Google reviews fail to load) | reviews (5 reviews with a rating summary) | autoreplies (automatic replies on: chip On, Set to send on its own). Old names still work: quiet, auto, nosocials, addon, error. The "What people say about you" card now sits below the conversations. States (load /?audit=normal&listenstate=<state> first): ready (default), stale (last checked more than 10 days ago), notenough, off (feature off or never scored: nothing shown), error, locked (no Inbox add-on: nothing shown), empty (same as off), waiting. Mock: GET /listening in mock-session.js.

routes.note: My plan now returns a realistic plan (claims with tags, effort, roadmap, calendar, pillars); variants ?planstate= ready (default, with the planner additions: offline rows, numbers to watch and the mix) | premix (a plan stored before the additions) | old (no icp, effort, roadmap, calendar or pillars) | building | failed | stale | none. My plan with a finished plan, so the "What people say about you" card shows under the competitor card. Same listenstate variants as inbox; locked shows one calm line with See plans; recent negative comments show on the Inbox only.

routes.label: competitors

Variants (load /?audit=normal&compstate=<state> first): locked (no add-on: a calm note and See plans, no card), empty, error, puterr / put403 / put429 (saving a handle is refused), trackeroff, waiting, states (one tile per handle state), few (too few posts for a pattern). Tiles, What's working and Trending for you: bestPostsAnswer() in mock-session.js. Mock: COMP_ROWS in mock-session.js. The draft actions and sheet follow ?draftstate= (see dashboard).
